build.compiler:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.5.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/bin

policy.openingBranches: union of historical and 5-ply openings within .040
policy.replyScreen: every historical retained candidate (at least 10 or all); new boards: all legal moves at 3 ply, retain at least 10 plus .080
policy.replyFinalists: union of 3- and 4-ply top two and every candidate within .040 at either depth
policy.innerSearch: GNUbg pruning enabled; deterministic, zero noise
